sourceChecks.claim: Live PostgreSQL concepts establishes relational tables; Architectural Fundamentals followup verifies separate server and application clients. Choice alternatives are appropriately conditional, not product capacity claims.
Live constraints documentation verifies CHECK accepts null, required NOT NULL, unique default null distinction, non-null unique primary keys and foreign-key reference rules.

Live transaction tutorial verifies commit/rollback as an all-or-nothing database boundary. Isolation and persistence documentation qualify concurrency and durability; external HTTP is not part of the described database boundary.

Live isolation documentation explicitly says Read Committed snapshots are per command and competing UPDATE waits then reevaluates WHERE on the updated row; this verifies the last-unit conditional update.
Live indexes introduction verifies scan avoidance, planner choice and write overhead; Using EXPLAIN followup defines plan inspection and representative cost variation.

Live warm standby documentation verifies WAL shipping/replay, asynchronous loss risk, configured sync stages and latency/availability costs. Failover followup verifies sole-primary authority and routing.

Live continuous archiving verifies backup/WAL recovery history. Connection-settings followup explicitly links max_connections to resource allocation; warm standby and indexing sections verify replica/index operating costs.

Live concepts page supports relational organization but is not alone a design recipe. Checked constraints, transaction isolation, index plans, replication and recovery sections substantiate this card's requirement-to-mechanism synthesis.
